runtime_prompt_en:
Image 1 is the sole identity and adult-age reference.

Create a photorealistic military editorial photograph with a modern Republic of Korea special-forces concept. The subject is the same unmistakably adult woman from the reference portrait, preserving her facial proportions, brown eyes, natural skin texture, and long dark wavy hair. Keep her eye aperture and spacing, face length, jaw width, hairline, natural asymmetry, and adult age continuous with the reference. She pauses at the edge of a rain-darkened training compound, one gloved hand adjusting her radio headset while she scans the corridor ahead. Her hair is partly secured beneath a matte helmet; olive-and-charcoal combat clothing, a fitted plate carrier, utility pouches, and a compact carbine carry believable weight. Use a vertical three-quarter-length frame: her face, adjusting hand, and secured carbine form a clean diagonal, with the camera slightly below eye level. The same cool dawn light grazes her cheek, helmet rim, and wet plate-carrier fabric while concrete reflections rise as soft fill. Fine rain beads cling to the helmet and darken the worn nylon seams. Keep her posture disciplined and alert; shallow 70 mm depth completes the grounded training-documentary atmosphere.

Avoid: excessive HDR, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, plastic-looking skin, broken facial features, low resolution, cartoon style, body distortion
